MASTER EQUIPMENT LEASE AGREEMENT

This Master Equipment Lease Agreement (this "Lease") is entered into as of June 15, 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Ironwood Capital Leasing LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Lessor"), and Grandview Bottling Company, Inc., a Michigan corporation ("Lessee").

1. Lease of Equipment.

Lessor leases to Lessee, and Lessee leases from Lessor, the personal property described in each schedule executed by the parties and incorporated into this Lease (each, a "Schedule", and the property described in a Schedule, the "Equipment"). Each Schedule is a separate lease that incorporates the terms of this Lease. If a Schedule conflicts with this Lease, the Schedule controls for that Schedule only.

2. Term.

The term of each Schedule begins on the Acceptance Date stated in that Schedule and continues for the number of months stated in it, and is not cancelable by Lessee except as Section 14 expressly permits. This Lease continues until the last Schedule expires or is terminated.

3. Rent.

Lessee shall pay Lessor the monthly rent stated in each Schedule, in advance, on the first day of each month, without notice or demand, at the address Lessor designates. Rent for a partial first month is prorated. Rent not paid within ten (10) days after it is due bears a late charge of the lesser of five percent (5%) of the overdue amount and the maximum rate permitted by applicable law.

4. Net Lease; Hell or High Water.

This Lease is a net lease. Lessee's obligation to pay rent and all other amounts is absolute and unconditional, is not subject to any abatement, reduction, setoff, defense, counterclaim, or recoupment for any reason, and continues regardless of any defect in, damage to, loss of, or interference with the Equipment, any claim Lessee has against Lessor or any manufacturer or supplier, or any other event. Lessee waives, to the extent permitted by law, the rights and remedies conferred on a lessee by Sections 2A-508 through 2A-522 of the Uniform Commercial Code.

5. Finance Lease Status.

The parties intend that each Schedule be a "finance lease" as defined in Section 2A-103(1)(g) of the Uniform Commercial Code. Lessee acknowledges that: (a) Lessor has not selected, manufactured, or supplied the Equipment; (b) Lessor acquired the Equipment in connection with this Lease; and (c) Lessee has received, and has had an opportunity to review, an accurate and complete statement of the promises and warranties, including disclaimers and limitations of remedies, provided to Lessor by the supplier in connection with the Equipment, as required by Section 2A-209 of the Uniform Commercial Code.

6. Acceptance.

Lessee shall inspect each item of Equipment on delivery and shall sign and deliver an acceptance certificate within five (5) business days after delivery. Lessee's use of an item of Equipment is acceptance of it. Acceptance is final and irrevocable.

7. Disclaimer of Warranties.

LESSOR IS NOT THE MANUFACTURER OR SUPPLIER OF THE EQUIPMENT AND MAKES NO WARRANTY, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING ANY WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, TITLE, OR NON-INFRINGEMENT, AND NO WARRANTY AS TO THE DESIGN, CONDITION, CAPACITY, PERFORMANCE, OR SUITABILITY OF THE EQUIPMENT. Lessor assigns to Lessee, for the term of the applicable Schedule, whatever warranty rights Lessor has against the manufacturer or supplier, to the extent assignable, and Lessee may pursue them directly at its own expense.

8. Use, Maintenance, and Location.

Lessee shall use the Equipment only in the conduct of its business, in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and all applicable law, and shall keep it in good repair at Lessee's expense, ordinary wear and tear excepted. Lessee shall maintain the Equipment at the location stated in the applicable Schedule and shall not move it without Lessor's prior written consent, which Lessor shall not unreasonably withhold.

9. Title; Personal Property; Filings.

Title to the Equipment remains in Lessor at all times. The Equipment is and remains personal property regardless of how it is attached to real property. Lessee shall not permit any lien or encumbrance to attach to the Equipment other than a lien created by Lessor. Lessee authorizes Lessor to file financing statements describing the Equipment, and Lessee shall obtain a landlord's or mortgagee's waiver for any location Lessee does not own.

10. Risk of Loss; Casualty.

Lessee bears the entire risk of loss of or damage to the Equipment from the time of delivery until it is returned. If an item of Equipment is lost, stolen, destroyed, or damaged beyond repair, Lessee shall, at Lessor's option, either repair it or pay Lessor the stipulated loss value stated in the applicable Schedule, less any insurance proceeds Lessor actually receives.

11. Insurance.

Lessee shall maintain, at its expense: all-risk property insurance on the Equipment for not less than its stipulated loss value, naming Lessor as loss payee; and commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 in the aggregate, naming Lessor as additional insured. Each policy shall require thirty (30) days' written notice to Lessor before cancellation. Lessee shall deliver certificates before delivery of any Equipment and on each renewal.

12. Taxes and Indemnity.

Lessee shall pay all taxes, fees, and charges imposed on the Equipment or its use, other than taxes on Lessor's net income. Lessee shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Lessor and its affiliates from all claims, losses, damages, liabilities, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising out of the Equipment or its selection, delivery, possession, use, condition, or return, except to the extent caused by Lessor's gross negligence or willful misconduct. Lessor shall give Lessee prompt written notice of any such claim, shall permit Lessee to control the defense with counsel reasonably acceptable to Lessor, and shall cooperate at Lessee's expense. This indemnity survives the expiration or termination of this Lease.

13. Default.

Lessee is in default if: (a) Lessee fails to pay any amount within ten (10) days after it is due; (b) Lessee fails to perform any other obligation and does not cure the failure within thirty (30) days after written notice; (c) any representation of Lessee proves to have been untrue when made; (d) Lessee becomes the subject of a bankruptcy, insolvency, or receivership proceeding that is not dismissed within sixty (60) days; or (e) Lessee ceases to do business.

14. Remedies.

On a default, Lessor may, in addition to any remedy available at law: terminate any or all Schedules; take possession of the Equipment, and Lessee shall make it available at a location Lessor reasonably designates; recover all unpaid rent then due plus the present value of the remaining rent for the balance of the term, discounted at four percent (4%) per year, plus the anticipated residual value of the Equipment; and recover its reasonable costs of enforcement, including attorneys' fees. Lessor shall apply the net proceeds of any re-lease or sale of the Equipment against the amounts Lessee owes. Lessor's remedies are cumulative, and no delay in exercising a remedy waives it.

15. Return.

On expiration or earlier termination of a Schedule, Lessee shall, at its expense, return the Equipment to a location Lessor designates within the continental United States, in the condition required by Section 8, properly packed for shipment, with all manuals and accessories, and in good working order certified by an authorized service representative.

16. End of Term.

Not less than one hundred twenty (120) days and not more than one hundred eighty (180) days before a Schedule expires, Lessee shall give Lessor written notice electing to return the Equipment, to renew the Schedule for a stated term, or to purchase the Equipment at its then fair market value. If Lessee gives no notice, the Schedule renews on a month-to-month basis at the same rent until Lessee gives ninety (90) days' written notice of return.

17. Assignment.

Lessee shall not assign this Lease or any Schedule, or sublease or part with possession of any Equipment, without Lessor's prior written consent. Lessor may assign this Lease or any Schedule, and may grant a security interest in the Equipment and the rent, without Lessee's consent; an assignee of Lessor takes free of any claim Lessee has against Lessor, but Lessor remains liable for its own obligations. Lessee shall, on request, deliver an acknowledgment to any assignee.

18. Notices.

All notices must be in writing and are effective on personal delivery, on the next business day after deposit with a nationally recognized overnight courier, or on the third business day after deposit in the United States mail, certified, postage prepaid, addressed to Lessor at 200 West Adams Street, Suite 1900, Chicago, Illinois 60606, and to Lessee at 4400 Grandview Road, Kalamazoo, Michigan 49004, or to any other address a party designates by notice.

19. Governing Law; Venue; Jury Waiver.

This Lease is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. Any action arising out of this Lease shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in Cook County, Illinois, and each party consents to the jurisdiction of those courts. EACH PARTY WAIVES ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION ARISING OUT OF THIS LEASE.

20. Miscellaneous.

This Lease, together with the Schedules, is the entire agreement of the parties on its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions. It may be amended only by a writing signed by both parties. If any provision is unenforceable, the remainder remains in effect. This Lease may be executed in counterparts. Only the original counterpart of a Schedule marked "Original" constitutes chattel paper for purposes of the Uniform Commercial Code.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Lease as of the Effective Date.
